title: Trust Center
lead: Security, data residency, and compliance information for PTTCRM prospects in the US, EU, and UK.
security_overview: PTTCRM is a marketing CRM operated with least-privilege access, encrypted transport (TLS 1.2+), and audit logging on demo and staff paths. Staff authentication uses the existing operations app — not embedded on this marketing site.

data_residency.statement_en: Production CRM and portal data for PTTCRM customers is hosted in Singapore unless contractually agreed otherwise.
